geometry_policy.primary: Manufacturer specification diagrams and dimension tables for the exact model and installed variant govern geometry wherever available.
geometry_policy.workflow: Use the original PDF and its dimensioned views to establish envelope, datums, profiles and feature positions before interpreting perspective photos. Cropped diagrams are navigation aids; preserve PDF vector detail.
geometry_policy.user_captures: Confirm installed accessory, visible details and movement; physical measurements fill undocumented dimensions with endpoints, units and uncertainty.
geometry_policy.online_photos: Support appearance and details absent from specification drawings; do not override dimensioned geometry from perspective appearance.
geometry_policy.conflicts: Record the source values and affected feature, check variant and measurement endpoints, and resolve the discrepancy explicitly before adopting a deviation. Do not silently override or average.
geometry_policy.unknowns: Label photo-derived and undocumented dimensions as estimates; do not invent missing engineering detail.

specification_sources.features: Sample compartment dimensions and unpacked instrument W477 x D567 x H196 mm; packed dimensions are not model geometry.
